description: GCP region GPU-quota CSV parsing and the accelerator-to-metric-name mapping. Extracted from the DNA-Entropy-Genbank prototype (commit 8026bf5c4afbe3021c1f7e79a17a93af4eaad84b) before its cloud/ package was gutted from the worker package (issue #280/#277). Reproduces `dna_entropy.cloud.gcloud.list_region_gpu_quota` and `dna_entropy.cloud.gcloud.gpu_quota_metric` for a future C# `DnaEntropyGraph.Core.GpuPlanner` (see docs/migration/2026-09-19-worker-migration-inventory.md, 'cloud/gcloud.py — GCP wrapper surface').

gpu_quota_metric.description: Maps a GPU accelerator type string to its Compute Engine quota metric name. Matching is case-insensitive substring matching, checked in order l4 -> a100 -> t4 -> v100, falling back to GPUS_ALL_REGIONS for anything unrecognized.

cases.note: Supplementary: v100 branch exists in gpu_quota_metric's source but has no dedicated parametrized test case in the prototype.

list_region_gpu_quota.function_signature: list_region_gpu_quota(metrics: Sequence[str], project: Optional[str] = None, *, timeout: float = 60) -> Optional[dict[str, dict[str, float]]]
list_region_gpu_quota.description: Runs a single `gcloud compute regions list --flatten=quotas[] --format=csv[no-heading](name,quotas.metric,quotas.limit,quotas.usage)` call and parses the CSV into {region: {metric: available}}. available = limit - usage, clamped at 0. Rows whose metric is not in the requested set, or whose limit is <= 0, are dropped. Returns None (distinct from an empty dict) when the underlying gcloud query itself fails, so callers can tell 'quota unknown' apart from 'quota is genuinely zero everywhere'.

row_notes.us-east1,NVIDIA_L4_GPUS,0.0,0.0: limit <= 0 -> dropped entirely (no quota granted at all, not the same as 'fully used')
row_notes.europe-west4,NVIDIA_A100_GPUS,4.0,4.0: 4 - 4 = 0 available, but limit > 0 so the region/metric IS kept, with value 0.0

cases.note: Non-zero gcloud return code (or a GcloudError/subprocess timeout) means the query failed; the function returns None, which callers must treat as 'unknown', not 'zero'.
An empty metrics list short-circuits to {} before any gcloud call is made.
